warning: This proposal uses valueless testnet assets and a synthetic mechanism-test price. It is not a live equity quote, issuer endorsement, audit, mainnet readiness statement, or transaction authorization.

privilegedBuyerRisk.finding: The buyer is a dedicated third unprivileged actor, distinct from the writer and shared deployer/guardian/treasurer.
containment: only ordinary WETH, ERC20, Permit2, UniversalRouter, CollateralTracker, and PanopticPool user calls are proposed
no registry, guardian, treasurer, ownership, factory-admin, upgrade, or deployment call is permitted
all public execution fields remain false and every nonce remains null

rehearsalOnlyExpiry.rule: A public candidate must replace this with a fresh, short-lived deadline and Permit2 expiry after exact-head replay.

transactions.label: buyer wraps bounded native ETH for WETH collateral
mandatoryPostconditions: buyer WETH increases by exactly valueWei
buyer native reserve remains above the frozen floor

transactions.label: writer approves exact total PLTR swap budget to Permit2
mandatoryPostconditions: PLTR ERC20 allowance equals the exact total swap budget and no more

transactions.label: writer approves exact total WETH swap budget to Permit2
mandatoryPostconditions: WETH ERC20 allowance equals the exact total swap budget and no more

transactions.label: writer grants exact PLTR Permit2 allowance to UniversalRouter
mandatoryPostconditions: Permit2 PLTR allowance equals the exact total budget and rehearsal-only expiry

transactions.label: writer grants exact WETH Permit2 allowance to UniversalRouter
mandatoryPostconditions: Permit2 WETH allowance equals the exact total budget and rehearsal-only expiry

transactions.label: writer swaps tiny exact-input PLTR to WETH
mandatoryPostconditions: receipt contains the exact PoolId swap event
input spend does not exceed amountIn
output received is at least amountOutMinimum
tick and sqrtPrice move in the expected direction

transactions.label: writer swaps tiny exact-input WETH to PLTR
mandatoryPostconditions: receipt contains the exact PoolId swap event
input spend does not exceed amountIn
output received is at least amountOutMinimum
tick and sqrtPrice move in the expected direction

transactions.label: writer approves exact PLTR collateral to tracker0
mandatoryPostconditions: PLTR allowance to tracker0 equals the next deposit and no more

transactions.label: writer deposits exact PLTR collateral
mandatoryPostconditions: tracker0 shares and assets increase by previewDeposit/asset deltas
PLTR allowance to tracker0 is zero after transferFrom

transactions.label: writer approves exact WETH collateral to tracker1
mandatoryPostconditions: WETH allowance to tracker1 equals the next deposit and no more

transactions.label: writer deposits exact WETH collateral
mandatoryPostconditions: tracker1 shares and assets increase by previewDeposit/asset deltas
WETH allowance to tracker1 is zero after transferFrom

transactions.label: buyer approves exact PLTR collateral to tracker0
mandatoryPostconditions: PLTR allowance to tracker0 equals the next deposit and no more

transactions.label: buyer deposits exact PLTR collateral
mandatoryPostconditions: tracker0 shares and assets increase by previewDeposit/asset deltas
PLTR allowance to tracker0 is zero after transferFrom

transactions.label: buyer approves exact WETH collateral to tracker1
mandatoryPostconditions: WETH allowance to tracker1 equals the next deposit and no more

transactions.label: buyer deposits exact WETH collateral
mandatoryPostconditions: tracker1 shares and assets increase by previewDeposit/asset deltas
WETH allowance to tracker1 is zero after transferFrom

transactions.label: writer opens bounded in-range short call
mandatoryPostconditions: writer owns exactly one leg with the planned TokenId and size
writer remains solvent at every verifier tick

transactions.label: buyer opens bounded matched long call
mandatoryPostconditions: buyer owns exactly one leg with the matched chunk and planned size
buyer and writer remain solvent

transactions.label: writer performs controlled PLTR-to-WETH premium-driving swap
mandatoryPostconditions: receipt contains the exact PoolId swap event
input spend does not exceed amountIn
output received is at least amountOutMinimum
tick and sqrtPrice move in the expected direction

transactions.label: writer performs controlled WETH-to-PLTR premium-driving swap
mandatoryPostconditions: receipt contains the exact PoolId swap event
input spend does not exceed amountIn
output received is at least amountOutMinimum
tick and sqrtPrice move in the expected direction

transactions.label: buyer closes matched long call before writer
mandatoryPostconditions: buyer has zero open legs
premium and collateral deltas reconcile
writer remains solvent before its close

transactions.label: writer closes short call after buyer
mandatoryPostconditions: writer has zero open legs
SFPM balances and premium deltas reconcile
both actors become eligible for standard maxWithdraw

transactions.label: writer revokes PLTR Permit2 allowance to UniversalRouter
mandatoryPostconditions: Permit2 PLTR allowance amount is zero

transactions.label: writer revokes WETH Permit2 allowance to UniversalRouter
mandatoryPostconditions: Permit2 WETH allowance amount is zero

transactions.label: writer clears PLTR ERC20 allowance to Permit2
mandatoryPostconditions: PLTR ERC20 allowance to Permit2 is zero

transactions.label: writer clears WETH ERC20 allowance to Permit2
mandatoryPostconditions: WETH ERC20 allowance to Permit2 is zero

blockingReasons: the dual-sender one-step operator has not yet passed exact-head simulation
no hash-bound public authorization manifest exists
each sender keystore must independently derive its committed role address
